reader.requirement: On a LINAGE file, a WRITE with NOT END-OF-PAGE must run imperative-statement-2 after the record is written only when the WRITE succeeds and no end-of-page condition (footing reached, GR18) or page overflow (LINAGE-COUNTER would exceed the page body, including ADVANCING PAGE) occurs; an unsuccessful WRITE runs neither phrase.
reader.edition-search: Read EmitWrite's END-OF-PAGE branch (the __wst success snapshot and FileEndOfPage test) and grepped 'Edition|IsActive|DialectBehavior' over SequentialConnector.cs: no edition test; NamedRecordEntry (SequentialIoEmitter) is the only edition site in EmitWrite and is not reached for a file without SELECT WHEN.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers AFTER 1 LINE and ADVANCING PAGE without FOOTING; the footing-area end-of-page, the automatic page overflow of a plain WRITE, BEFORE ADVANCING at the last line, ADVANCING 0, the AT/NOT pair together and an unsuccessful WRITE are not exercised

probes.printed: LINAGE 5 FOOTING 4, AT EOP + NOT AT EOP: W1 NOT (LC 2), W2 NOT (3), W3 EOP (4), W4 EOP (5), W5 EOP (overflow, LC 1), W6 NOT (2), W7 NOT (3); NOT alone BEFORE ADVANCING 1: N1 (to 4) and N2 (5) silent, N3 overflow silent (LC 1), N4/N5 NOT; ADVANCING 0 LINES at LC 3: Z0 NOT, LC 3
probes.expected: GR9: NOT phrase only when GR18's end-of-page (LINAGE-COUNTER equal or exceed integer-2) and the page overflow do not occur; GR16 c zero advance is no repositioning

probes.printed: WRITE with NOT AT END-OF-PAGE on an unopened file: 'DECL 48', no 'U0 NOT-EOP'
probes.expected: GR9 (amended) 'during the successful execution' only; GR10 the USE procedure on the unsuccessful WRITE

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR9  (4.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR9
OK  §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR18  (4.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR18

reader.notes: The NOT arm is guarded on a status snapshot taken before the FILE STATUS store and on the connector's end-of-page flag read in the if header, so a failed WRITE and both end-of-page shapes suppress it. The behaviour follows the Amendment 2 text of GR9, which the transcription applies in place.

refuter.evidence: reop1-001 (--std 85): LINAGE 3 with NO FOOTING -> A1 NOT (LC2), A2 NOT (LC3, last body line, no footing EOP per §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR1), A3 overflow EOP (LC1), A4 NOT; LINAGE DN1 FOOTING DN2 (DN2 4 at OPEN, set to 2 after) with LINES AT TOP/BOTTOM -> page 1 EOP from LC4 (footing fixed at OPEN), after overflow page 2 EOP from LC2 (DN2 re-read at page change, GR8); NOT-only WRITE AFTER 3 reaching the footing line -> silent; AFTER 0 LINES on the footing line LC5 -> EOP, NOT suppressed; AFTER 3 from LC5 -> overflow EOP; RECORD VARYING violation (44) on a LINAGE file -> DECL 44, neither phrase. reop2-002: WRITE AFTER ADVANCING PAGE NOT AT END-OF-PAGE compiles at 85 (SR7 bars only END-OF-PAGE) and the NOT phrase does NOT run: the compiler treats ADVANCING PAGE as page overflow (SequentialConnector#PositionOnLogicalPage, lines<0 arm). That reading holds in the 1985 text: §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR9c says during the reset 'LINAGE-COUNTER is implicitly incremented to exceed the value specified by integer-1', which is GR18's page overflow ('simultaneously exceed the value of both integer-2 ... and integer-1'), so the end-of-page condition occurs and imperative-statement-2 is not executed; the reader's requirement already names ADVANCING PAGE. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR9; OK GR18; OK §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR9c, GR1, GR8; OK §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR7.
